name: oletools
label: OLETools
description: This is an automation to run oletools malware analysis for office files. Oletools is a tool for analyzing Microsoft OLE2 files, such as Microsoft Office documents or Outlook messages, mainly for malware analysis, forensics, and debugging. This automation allows performing some basic oletools commands from Cortex XSOAR. Note that oletools is open source code and is subject to change.

parameters.title: ole command
parameters.name: oleCommand
parameters.tooltip: The ole command to activate. oleid - to analyze OLE files to detect specific characteristics usually found in malicious files. oleobj - to extract embedded objects from OLE files. olevba - to extract and analyze VBA Macro source code from MS Office docume

parameters.title: entryID
parameters.name: entryID
parameters.tooltip: The file to activate the oletools analysis on.

parameters.title: decode
parameters.name: decode
parameters.tooltip: Display all the obfuscated strings with their decoded content (Hex, Base64, StrReverse, Dridex, VBA). Note that this works only with the olevba command.

parameters.title: password
parameters.name: password
parameters.tooltip: If encrypted office files are encountered, try decryption with this password. (if specified dont specify the non_secret_password parameter).

parameters.title: non secret password
parameters.name: nonSecretPassword
parameters.tooltip: If encrypted office files are encountered, try decryption with this password. This argument is non secret for playbook flows. (if specified dont specify the password parameter).
